message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No credible vulnerabilities newly reported in the last 24 hours matched the components and versions in the assigned DLL inventory.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only. Duplicate component names and obvious naming variants were normalized. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-29 13:10 IST through 2026-10-30 13:10 IST (2026-10-29 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-30 07:40 UTC).

### Findings

No relevant new vulnerabilities were verified. Same-window GitHub Advisory Database results for NuGet and npm did not identify the monitored packages, and vendor-focused checks produced no fresh, credible match. General .NET advisories outside the exact component scope and older advisories outside the time window were excluded.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and major libraries, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB's security alerts, CVE/NVD-linked records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. No MongoDB-related vulnerability was newly reported in this exact 24-hour window. MongoDB's newest security alert was dated October 26 and was excluded as stale.

### Sources checked

- [GitHub Advisory Database: NuGet](https://github.com/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Anuget+published%3A2026-10-29..2026-10-30)
- [GitHub Advisory Database: npm](https://github.com/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Anpm+published%3A2026-10-29..2026-10-30)
- [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)
- [CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog)

### Review priority

No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported vulnerabilities in this scan window. Continue normal monitoring; this result does not reassess older known vulnerabilities already associated with legacy component versions.
